message.content:
I don’t have real‑time data on Los Angeles’ air quality. For the most up‑to‑date information you can check:

- **AirNow** (https://www.airnow.gov) – provides current AQI values for U.S. cities, including Los Angeles.
- **AQICN** (https://aqicn.org/city/los-angeles/) – offers live air‑quality maps and historical data.
- Local news outlets or the City of Los Angeles’ environmental website often publish daily air‑quality reports.

If you’d like a quick snapshot, you can also use a weather app that includes AQI, or search “Los Angeles air quality” in your browser for the latest readings.
